why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Follow Optimum on X and join its Discord, discord.gg/getoptimum, and turn on notifications. Codes go fast.
When a code drops, open the official mint site: "Official mint site: https://turbocards.getoptimum.xyz/optimum".

Press Follow Optimum, connect an EVM wallet on Ethereum mainnet, enter the code and mint. You'll pay Ethereum gas. Warning Fake codes and links circulate under Optimum's posts. Optimum says: "1 code = 1 card. Only trust codes and links from official Optimum channels." The mint never needs your seed phrase.
Keep the card in the wallet that minted it. It can't be moved or sold.
If you run Ethereum validators, you can also connect them for free: "Boost your node for free at: https://console.getoptimum.xyz".
